spec: CORE §5 RegistryBootstrapDescriptor; DACS-1 §6.3.4 LRR-2; DACS-2 §7.4.3; DACS-4 §9.4.3
decisionModel: A release-pinned sequence-one descriptor starts a non-recursive immutable registry-index chain; exact predecessor authorization, optional new-key acceptance, finality evidence, snapshot hashes, rollback, forks, and definition checks are independently enforced.
hashRecipe: sha256(compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON of vectors)

vectors.name: valid-recipe-registry-root
vectors.reason: the pinned recipe root verifies without consulting the recipe registry

vectors.name: valid-rail-registry-root
vectors.reason: the pinned rail root verifies without consulting the rail registry

vectors.name: hash-only-first-contact-pin
vectors.reason: a canonical sequence-1 descriptor hash is a sufficient release pin

vectors.name: key-only-first-contact-pin
vectors.reason: a canonical sequence-1 authority key is a sufficient release pin

vectors.name: transport-without-release-pin-is-rejected
vectors.reason: HTTPS and repository retrieval are transport, not bootstrap authority

vectors.name: registry-kind-logical-address-pairing-mismatch
vectors.reason: the self-describing logical address must match the exact kind pairing

vectors.name: descriptor-receipt-substrate-mismatch
vectors.reason: the embedded receipt substrate must equal the descriptor substrate

vectors.name: descriptor-receipt-logical-address-mismatch
vectors.reason: the embedded receipt logical address must equal the registry logical address

vectors.name: descriptor-receipt-native-address-mismatch
vectors.reason: the embedded receipt native address must equal the immutable snapshot address

vectors.name: descriptor-receipt-content-hash-mismatch
vectors.reason: the embedded receipt content hash must equal the descriptor snapshot hash

vectors.name: non-final-bootstrap-receipt
vectors.reason: registry bootstrap requires established finalized evidence

vectors.name: unavailable-bootstrap-receipt-evidence
vectors.reason: unavailable otherwise-valid finality evidence cannot become pass or fail

vectors.name: recursive-bootstrap-evidence
vectors.reason: bootstrap finality proof cannot depend on the registry being bootstrapped

vectors.name: same-key-content-successor
vectors.reason: each immutable index-byte update advances sequence and is authorized by the predecessor key

vectors.name: two-signature-key-rotation
vectors.reason: rotation requires predecessor delegation and exact new-key acceptance

vectors.name: rotation-missing-predecessor-authorization
vectors.reason: an invalid rotation is discarded and cannot replace the accepted root

vectors.name: rotation-missing-new-key-acceptance
vectors.reason: a rotation without new-key acceptance is discarded and the accepted root remains

vectors.name: sequence-skip-is-rejected
vectors.reason: a sequence-skipping candidate is discarded and cannot advance the accepted chain

vectors.name: successor-registry-tuple-change
vectors.reason: a tuple-changing candidate is discarded and cannot advance the accepted chain

vectors.name: authority-key-alias-is-rejected
vectors.reason: key identifiers are exactly key plus raw lower-case Ed25519 public bytes

vectors.name: active-key-cannot-be-revoked
vectors.reason: the descriptor's active authority cannot appear in its revocation set

vectors.name: revocation-set-cannot-shrink
vectors.reason: a successor with non-cumulative revocations is discarded

vectors.name: revocation-set-cannot-contain-duplicates
vectors.reason: a successor with duplicate revocations is discarded

vectors.name: revocation-set-order-is-canonical
vectors.reason: a successor with non-canonical revocation order is discarded

vectors.name: revoked-predecessor-cannot-authorize
vectors.reason: an invalid candidate that revokes its active authority is discarded

vectors.name: two-valid-successors-are-a-fork
vectors.reason: transport order cannot choose a valid successor fork

vectors.name: valid-and-unavailable-successors-remain-unresolved
vectors.reason: proof availability cannot select one of two predecessor-authorized signed candidates

vectors.name: invalid-successor-is-discarded
vectors.reason: an invalid sibling candidate is discarded before the one valid successor advances

vectors.name: key-only-sequence-one-fork
vectors.reason: a key-only first-contact pin cannot choose between two valid roots

vectors.name: latest-mode-rollback-is-rejected
vectors.reason: a lower sequence than persisted latest state is rollback

vectors.name: historical-replay-uses-recorded-sequence
vectors.reason: historical replay selects the exact retained sequence-and-descriptor-hash pair

vectors.name: historical-replay-requires-descriptor-hash
vectors.reason: a numeric registry sequence alone is not authenticated replay authority

vectors.name: historical-replay-refuses-unrelated-descriptor
vectors.reason: an exact target hash outside the validated predecessor chain cannot be selected

vectors.name: content-change-at-same-native-address
vectors.reason: a same-address content replacement is discarded and cannot advance the chain

vectors.name: missing-index-snapshot-bytes
vectors.reason: an otherwise valid descriptor cannot be used until exact snapshot bytes are available

vectors.name: stale-index-snapshot-bytes
vectors.reason: stale bytes that miss the pinned hash cannot become an unpinned latest index

vectors.name: authenticated-index-definition-reference
vectors.reason: an entry in a verified immutable index is an authenticated content reference

vectors.name: definition-content-hash-mismatch
vectors.reason: definition bytes must match the authenticated entry hash

vectors.name: definition-bytes-unavailable
vectors.reason: unavailable referenced definition bytes remain indeterminate

vectors.name: definition-signature-or-semantics-fail
vectors.reason: the authenticated locator does not waive the definition's own checks

vectors.name: signed-unknown-member-is-preserved
vectors.reason: SIG-5 includes unknown members in the descriptor hash and signature

vectors.name: signed-unknown-member-is-nfc-canonical
vectors.reason: descriptor hashing applies CF-1 NFC to signed unknown string values

vectors.name: unsafe-integer-in-unknown-member-is-rejected
vectors.reason: descriptor hashing rejects integers outside the JCS safe subset

vectors.name: float-in-unknown-member-is-rejected
vectors.reason: descriptor hashing rejects unsupported floating-point values fail closed

vectors.name: unknown-member-mutation-without-resigning
vectors.reason: a verifier cannot strip or mutate an unknown member before hashing

vectors.name: cross-domain-signature-replay
vectors.reason: a valid Ed25519 signature under another domain is not bootstrap authorization

vectors.name: extra-bootstrap-discriminator-is-rejected
vectors.reason: multiple structural bootstrap discriminators are refused before interpretation
